paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: : Loss Ratio FLOPs
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the loss ratio as a function of TFLOPs for five different model configurations: Vanilla, SepLLM with 64 and 128 parameters, and two variants of SepLLM with 64 parameters incorporating H and H/T compression. The x-axis represents TFLOPs on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1e7 to 9e8. The y-axis represents the Loss Ratio (%) on a linear scale, ranging from 94% to 100%. The Vanilla configuration (purple, triangle markers, solid line) remains constant at 100% across the entire range. The SepLLM (n=64) configuration (orange, circle markers, solid line) starts at approximately 98.3% and rises to a peak of 100% at 4e8 TFLOPs before slightly declining. The SepLLM (n=128) configuration (blue, cross markers, solid line) begins at 97% and steadily increases to 100% by 2e8 TFLOPs, then remains relatively flat. The SepLLM (n=64, H) configuration (green, diamond markers, solid line) starts at 97.5% and increases to 100% by 4e8 TFLOPs, showing minor fluctuations. The SepLLM (n=64, H/T) configuration (red, square markers, solid line) begins at 94% and rises sharply to 99% by 2e8 TFLOPs, then plateaus near 99% for the remainder of the range.
